item.title: Shrinkwrap 0.8.0
item.description: One folder instead of four: z_originals, x_backups, y_leftovers and a_image-logs.txt now live together inside z_backups/ as originals/, backups/, leftovers/ and image-logs.txt. Existing folders migrate themselves on the next run, keeping the log — and with it every record of what was already made — intact.
